title: Chat.activeCallId across hosting accounts
description: With the shared-account model (VTCCall lives in its hosting account), chat-00 sets Chat.activeCallId on the Chat named by chatId, which must be in the hosting account. Chat uses per-owner copies, so other members' copies of the Chat live in their own accounts and activeCallId there would name a call in a different account, with no accountId to resolve it. Decide: add activeCallAccountId, or define activeCallId as resolved in the call's hosting account. Same question for federation's locally created VTCCall (which account).
close_reason: Chat.activeCallAccountId added (chat-00) and referenced in vtc-00 and guides.
